name: ai-crew-sync
description: Coordination bus for a team of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client): shared messaging, task claims, presence, notes, locks and real-time wakeups over one MCP server backed by Postgres.

plugins.name: ai-crew-sync
plugins.description: Connects this Claude Code to your team's bus: MCP tools preconfigured, automatic presence heartbeats, catch-up on session start, and /ai-crew-sync:standup, /ai-crew-sync:catchup, /ai-crew-sync:announce commands.
